people.name: Pharaoh
people.line: Egyptian Pharaoh during Moses' birth and early life

translations.web: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” The woman took the child, and nursed it.
translations.bsb: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child and nurse him for me, and I will pay your wages.” So the woman took the boy and nursed him.
